apps.name: Ksign
apps.localizedDescription: Yet another codesigning app, have you ever wondered what if Feather and Esign had a child? Welcome to Ksign!
apps.subtitle: The "cleaner" Esign app.

versions.localizedDescription:
This version introduces:

- Update checker with badge notifications and background refresh
- Pull-to-refresh in Library view
- Dark theme persistence fix on app restart
- Update All button for bulk app updates
- Smart update deduplication across sources
- Stale update cleanup when deleting apps
- Patch notes viewer on About page
- Rebranded to C0st1 with custom bundle ID (com.c0st1.ksign)
- Removed donations, Telegram, and Discord from settings
- Removed developer repo from default sources
- GitHub Repository and About (GitHub profile) links in settings
